player_prompt.intro:
I player {player_id} ni e, ‘Rock-Paper-Scissors’ game round {num_rounds} ah khel tur a ni.
I tihtur ber chu round ‘tam tak’ i win theihtir nan a ni.
Round reng reng ah hian i response tur te chu: '[rock]', '[paper]', '[scissors]' zawk ah thlang rawh.
I ṭang chuan '[r]', '[p]', '[s]' hmang thei bawk a ni.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move hi hriat loh a ni. [rock], [paper], [scissors] hi hmang rawh.

message.round_draw: Round result: Draw a ni ang.

outcome.p0_wins: Player 0 chuan round tam ber a hneh!
outcome.p1_wins: Player 1 chuan round tam ber a hneh!
